base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019" FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_012"
INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2."XCL_013" = T3."XCL_030"
INNER JOIN colour AS T4 ON T1."XCL_022" = T4."XCL_005"
WHERE T1."XCL_029" < 100
  AND T4."XCL_006" = 'Brown'
  AND T1."XCL_028" > 0.7 * (SELECT AVG("XCL_028") FROM superhero)
GROUP BY T1."XCL_018"
HAVING COUNT(T3."XCL_030") > 10
